claim.purpose: Prevent repository validation and owner-binary installation from mutating tracked Cargo.lock files

initial.title: [v0.91.8][tooling][lockfile] Prevent validation and binary installation from rewriting tracked Cargo.lock files
initial.goal: Make repository-native owner builds and validation lock-preserving and current-target-only.
initial.required_outcome: Failed or successful owner build paths leave the caller's exact Cargo.lock state unchanged unless dependency mutation is explicitly requested.
authority_boundary: Issue #5788 owns only repository lock-preservation and current owner-binary inventory
No dependency upgrade or lockfile content change is authorized
No tracked work occurs on main
initial.task_boundary: Use current targets, --locked, and exact pre-invocation byte restoration for invocation-created drift.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Removed target failure leaves Cargo.lock byte-identical
AC-2: Dependency-resolution drift is restored fail-closed
AC-3: Pre-existing user-owned lock changes remain byte-identical
AC-5: Default owner inventory contains only current Cargo targets
initial.plan_summary: Harden the two owner build paths, add fixture-only shell regressions, review exact head, and publish.

steps.action: Implement current inventory and lock guard
Run focused shell contracts and exact review

risks: Restoration could overwrite pre-existing user changes
Inventory could omit a current operational binary
invariants: Exact pre-invocation lock bytes are authoritative
No v1-sunset target returns to the inventory
review_prompts: Can any failure leave Cargo.lock changed?
Are all requested default bins current?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove current inventory and exact lockfile preservation
Prove validation plans use lock-preserving current targets

initial.failure_policy: Restore only invocation-created lock drift to exact pre-invocation bytes and return nonzero with the affected path.
